headline: Valero Energy Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Valero Energy (NYSE:VLO) reported second-quarter 2026 net income attributable to stockholders of $3.7 billion, or $12.62 per share, compared with $714 million, or $2.28 per share, a year earlier, as refining, renewable diesel and ethanol operations all posted stronger results.
